meaning: reports/release-control.json and reports/release-power.json say release_ready only when Synth's own routing and export gates pass. They are not review sign-off. This file stays false until every gate below is true.

multiboard_mapping.evidence: crates/synth-cli/tests/bldc_stack_board.rs: 20 of 20 J_B2B pins matched, 100%, no diagnostics; every pin of the connector appears exactly once.

negative_mappings.evidence: Swap (mappings_neg_swap.json), drop (mappings_neg_drop.json), 12V/3.3V exchange (mappings_neg_voltage.json) and a source-level pin swap (control_neg_swap.synth) each return status warning with E-SYNTH-MULTIBOARD-003, -004 or -005.

mechanical_alignment.evidence: Sidecar comparison in the same test: J_B2B is pinned at each right edge (origins 56.105,4.07 on the control and 70.15,14.57 on the power board) with equal rotation. The mounting holes are board-local: control (2,2)/(51,2)/(2,30)/(51,30), power (2,2)/(62.4,2)/(2,49)/(62.4,49). J_PWR/J_MOTOR are flush on the power board's left edge at origins (5.14,12.46) and (5.14,28.91), rotated 270 degrees.

routing_and_drc.evidence: FreeRouting 2.4.1 with Temurin 25 closes 39 of 40 nets with 0 DRC errors. The last open is a +3V3 decoupling island of 6 pads around U_LDO.2, not a missing trace; the GND pour splits are stitched by 9 interior vias. KiCadRoutingTools closes 39 of 40 with 0 DRC errors but places 13 vias inside U1 pads and fails its ground-return/plane-split gate. No engine yet returns fully connected, fabrication-clean copper; the un-routed control PCB reports 0 DRC errors, 97 unconnected pads and 3 silk warnings. The power board has an un-routed placement export: FreeRouting hit the 1200 s router budget, so reports/power.routing.json records a timeout and no partial board was installed. Its placement is DRC-clean (0 errors, 6 advisory warnings) after the sidecar was re-spaced onto legal courtyards; the board declares a 72 x 52 outline, J_B2B is flush right and J_PWR/J_MOTOR are flush left. The 179 unconnected pads are the un-routed nets (reports/power.drc.json). The delivered power PCB is rendered for review, not fabrication.

erc_dispositioned.evidence: kicad-cli sch erc reports 0 errors and 0 warnings on both schematics after the 2026-11-05 rerun. The gate stays false until a human reviewer signs the ERC result; there are no machine warnings left to disposition.

part_review.evidence: Every authored part has reviewed_by = "" by design, so W-SYNTH-PART-UNVERIFIED fires and `synth registry qualify` blocks on E-SYNTH-QUAL-008. No reviewer has checked the ten authored parts against their datasheets.

thermal_and_power.evidence: The AMS1117-3.3 estimate is 0.73 W in a 60 C/W package, about 107 C junction at 25 C ambient (W-SYNTH-THERMAL-001). No thermal measurement, no junction-temperature calculation for the MOSFETs, and no current-loop or EMI analysis.

connector_review.evidence: The 2.5 A/contact rating is from the LCSC product pages; the Phoenix terminal-block datasheets were read with Firecrawl on 2026-11-03 (17.5 A, 400 V III/2, 5.08 mm, LCSC C480516/C480520). The 50% derating and the current table are hand calculations; no stack-height, keying or creepage check was done.

fabrication_review.evidence: No Gerbers or drill files were generated because routing failed. No fab accepted the board, and 2 oz outer copper, via-in-pad and the 10 A terminals were not quoted.

hardware_test.evidence: not powered, not programmed, not measured

reproducible_hashes.evidence: SHA256SUMS was regenerated locally on 2026-11-05 and verifies. No CI run has produced a golden set for this board, and the routed artifact does not exist.

board_outline.evidence: crates/synth-cli/tests/board_outline.rs: a declared 60 x 30 fixture exports Edge.Cuts exactly at (0, 0)-(60, 30) mm, a mounting hole keeps its sidecar edge coordinate with no via in its corner, and a sidecar part outside the rectangle is E-SYNTH-PLACE-003.
